products.name: I-Col™
products.detailCategory: Synthetic Absorbable Suture · Braided · Polyglycolic Acid
products.description: I-Col™ is a synthetic absorbable braided suture made from Polyglycolic Acid (PGA), coated with Calcium Stearate and Polycaprolactone. It provides high initial tensile strength with predictable absorption — ideal for procedures requiring extended wound support.
features: High initial strength with moderated absorption kinetics
Excellent knot reliability and security
High biocompatibility — minimal tissue reaction
Perfect slide due to homogeneous calcium stearate coating
Available dyed (violet) and undyed
27% higher knot pull tensile strength than USP limit
applications: General soft tissue approximation and ligation

products.name: I-Col™ Fast
products.detailCategory: Synthetic Absorbable Suture · Braided · Short Term
products.description: I-Col™ Fast is a short-term synthetic absorbable braided suture made from treated Polyglycolic Acid. Spontaneous elimination after 10 days saves surgical time and provides excellent wound healing with very soft thread handling.
features: Gamma sterilization for superior sterility assurance
Excellent wound healing results
Very soft thread — excellent handling
Spontaneous elimination after 10 days
Short absorption profile for superficial/fast-healing procedures

products.name: Polycol™
products.description: Polycol™ is a synthetic absorbable braided suture made from Polyglactin 910, coated with Poly-Glycolide-co-Lactide and Calcium Stearate. It offers excellent tensile strength, improved handling and minimal tissue reaction.
features: Excellent tensile strength with improved handling
Minimal tissue reaction with predictable absorption
Available undyed and violet
Reliable knot security and smooth passage through tissue
23% above USP knot pull tensile strength limit

products.name: Stericryl™
products.description: Stericryl™ is a synthetic absorbable monofilament suture made from Poliglecaprone 25 (PGA-PCL). It features smooth atraumatic tissue penetration, mild tissue reactivity, and reduces postoperative adhesion.
features: Smooth atraumatic tissue penetration
Mild tissue reactivity — well tolerated
Reduces postoperative adhesion
Monofilament — easy passage through tissue
80% above USP knot pull tensile strength limit

products.name: Monocol™
products.description: Monocol™ is a long-term synthetic absorbable monofilament suture made from Polydioxanone (PDO). Provides sustained wound support over 60 days with homogeneous absorption kinetics and exceptional resistance in aggressive biological environments.
features: Optimal strength duration over 60 days
Homogeneous absorption kinetics across the whole range
Minimal tissue trauma and excellent tolerance
High strength in aggressive biological fluids
23% higher knot pull tensile strength than USP limit

products.shortSpecification:
PGA:TMC · Bioabsorbable · 10 Years Clinical
Results
Matrix for tissue generation & healing
products.description: GORE® BIO-A® Tissue Reinforcement is a uniquely designed web of biocompatible synthetic polymers (PGA:TMC) that is gradually absorbed by the body. Its 3D matrix of open, highly interconnected pores facilitates cell infiltration and tissue generation — leaving no permanent material behind. Backed by more than 20 years of research and clinical use.
features: 100% synthetic, bioabsorbable tissue scaffold — no human or animal tissue
Open, highly porous 3D web structure — similar to collagen fibre network
Rapid cell population and vascularisation within 1–2 weeks
Replaced 1:1 with patient's own native type I collagen
Absorbed by body over approximately 6–7 months (primarily by hydrolysis)
No soaking, refrigeration, or special tracking required
Trimmable — available in sizes up to 20 cm × 30 cm
Three-year shelf life
10 years of positive clinical results

PTFE + PGA:TMC · Permanent Strength · VHWG Grade
2
Material innovation for permanent strength
products.description: GORE® SYNECOR Intraperitoneal Biomaterial is a tri-layer hybrid solution designed for durable repair in complex patients (VHWG Grade 2). It combines a GORE 3D PGA:TMC Web Scaffold for rapid vascularisation, a macroporous PTFE knit for permanent strength, and a non-porous PGA:TMC film to minimise visceral attachment. Burst strength >500 N — designed to provide strength for large defects and higher BMIs.
features: Tri-layer hybrid design: GORE 3D PGA:TMC Web Scaffold + Macroporous PTFE knit + Non-porous PGA:TMC film
Permanent strength: Burst strength >500 N (nearly 2× the strength requirement for bridging ventral hernia repair)
PTFE knit — latest generation macroporous fibre designed for permanent strength
PTFE knit had least bacterial adherence vs competitive polypropylene knits (S. aureus study)
Rapid vascularisation: vascularity within 7 days, tissue ingrowth at 30 days, tissue generation at 180 days
Non-porous PGA:TMC film minimises visceral attachment — no adhesion complications at 12 months clinically
Minimal contraction: -5.1% at 31 days, -6.6% at 180 days (animal studies)
Flexible and conformable — material memory for easy unrolling and optimal placement
No pre-soaking needed (may be dipped in sterile saline to facilitate handling)
MRI and CT compatible — PTFE visible in high-resolution imaging
100% synthetic — no human, animal or tissue-derived materials
